# Docito® Terms of Service

**Effective Date:** 02.02.2026  
**Last Updated:** 02.02.2026

Docito® is a registered trademark and brand of **Artsy Developers Inc.**

Docito operates globally and is not “based” in any one country.

Contact: **[support@docito.app](mailto:support@docito.app)**

Docito does **not** make a blanket claim of HIPAA compliance. We use **privacy-first, security-focused, HIPAA-aligned practices**. **BAA support may be available upon request** only under a separate written agreement and only for eligible organizations and configurations.

Docito supports **care seekers, providers, clinics and practices, labs, imaging, pharmacies, staff, admins, and super-admins**. Features may include **bookings, referrals, messaging, records, files, notes, payments, analytics, verification, insurance information, and specialty-based UI**.

---

## 1) Who Docito Is For

Docito supports multiple roles, including:

- **Care Seekers** (people seeking healthcare services)
- **Providers** (doctors, dentists, specialists, and other licensed healthcare professionals)
- **Facilities** (clinics and practices, laboratories, imaging centers, pharmacies, and similar healthcare organizations)
- **Staff** (team members invited by Providers or Facilities)
- **Admins and Super-Admins** (users managing platform configuration, verification, and monitoring)

---

## 2) Definitions

- **Care Seeker** means a user seeking healthcare services or information.
- **Provider** means a licensed healthcare professional who offers services through Docito.
- **Facility** means a healthcare organization using Docito.
- **Staff** means any user invited by a Provider or Facility and assigned role-based permissions.
- **Booking** means an appointment request, service request, booking, referral appointment request, or scheduling action made through Docito.
- **Content** means any data or material uploaded, entered, posted, sent, stored, or generated through the Services, including messages, files, notes, templates, listings, schedules, and metadata.
- **PHI** (Protected Health Information) is defined in applicable U.S. law and generally refers to individually identifiable health information handled in regulated contexts.

---

## 3) What Docito Does (and Does Not Do)

### 3.1 Platform Services

Docito is a technology platform designed to help users:

- search and discover Providers and Facilities
- request and manage appointments and bookings
- communicate through messages and notifications
- coordinate referrals
- manage operational workflows such as staff management, calendars, and tasks
- manage records and documents such as notes, files, visit documentation, and summaries
- access analytics and reporting features
- support payments and subscriptions where enabled
- store and manage insurance information where enabled
- use specialty-based UI components (for example dental charting for dentists)

Features may vary by region, plan, and role.

### 3.2 Not Medical Advice; No Emergency Use

Docito does **not** provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment and is not a healthcare provider. All medical services are provided by Providers and Facilities, not by Docito.

Do **not** use Docito for emergencies. If you need urgent care, call your local emergency number immediately.

### 3.3 No Guarantee of Outcomes

Docito does not guarantee medical outcomes, provider availability, appointment acceptance, insurance coverage, reimbursement, or the quality of any Provider or Facility services.

---

## 4) Global Operation

Docito operates globally. Availability of certain features, legal requirements, and compliance obligations may vary by country and region. You are responsible for using the Services in compliance with your local laws and professional obligations.

---

## 5) Accounts, Security, and Responsibility

### 5.1 Account Registration

You must provide accurate information and keep it updated. You are responsible for all activity under your account.

### 5.2 Account Security

You must safeguard your credentials and immediately notify us of unauthorized access or suspected compromise at **[support@docito.app](mailto:support@docito.app)**.

### 5.3 Role-Based Access and Staff

Providers and Facilities may invite Staff and assign permissions. You are responsible for ensuring invited users are authorized, assigning appropriate permissions, removing access promptly when no longer needed, and ensuring your Staff comply with these Terms and applicable laws.

---

## 6) Provider and Facility Listings; Verification

### 6.1 Listings

Providers and Facilities may create listings containing profile details such as specialty, services, location, hours, and pricing where applicable. You must not post false or misleading information.

### 6.2 Verification (Optional)

Docito may offer verification workflows such as identity checks, license details, credential uploads, and affiliation confirmation. Verification may improve trust but does not guarantee clinical quality, competence, legality, or outcomes.

### 6.3 Professional Responsibility

Providers and Facilities remain solely responsible for maintaining valid licenses, credentials, approvals, and compliance with regulations in the jurisdictions where they operate.

---

## 7) Bookings, Appointments, Cancellations, and Referrals

### 7.1 Booking Requests and Confirmation

Bookings may be requests until confirmed. Providers and Facilities control availability and may accept, reject, or reschedule a Booking.

### 7.2 Cancellations and No-Shows

A Provider or Facility may enforce cancellation and no-show rules, including fees, disclosed during booking or in their policy settings where enabled. By booking, you agree to applicable policies displayed at the time of booking.

### 7.3 Referrals

Docito may support referral workflows between Providers and Facilities. Referrals do not guarantee acceptance or appointment availability. Responsibility for clinical decisions remains with Providers and Facilities.

---

## 8) Messaging and Communications

Docito may provide in-platform messaging and notifications between users and organizations. You agree not to use messaging to harass, threaten, or abuse users, share illegal content, send spam or unsolicited marketing, or request highly sensitive information in unsafe ways.

We may limit, moderate, or disable messaging to prevent abuse and protect users.

---

## 9) Records, Notes, Files, Templates, and Exports

### 9.1 Documentation Tools

Docito may include clinical documentation and workflow tools. Providers and Facilities are responsible for the accuracy and appropriateness of records created using Docito.

### 9.2 File Storage

You are responsible for ensuring you have the right to upload and share files and that you do not upload prohibited content.

### 9.3 Data Exports and PDFs

Docito may provide exports such as summaries and PDFs. Exports are provided as is and should be reviewed for accuracy before use.

### 9.4 Retention

Providers and Facilities are responsible for retention requirements for medical records and operational documents as required by law and professional rules.

---

## 10) Insurance Information (If Enabled)

Docito may allow Care Seekers to store insurance details and allow Providers and Facilities to record accepted plans. Docito does not guarantee eligibility, coverage, claim approval, reimbursement, or pricing accuracy unless expressly stated in a separate written agreement.

---

## 11) Payments, Fees, Subscriptions, and Taxes (If Enabled)

### 11.1 Payment Processing

Payments may be processed through third-party payment processors. You agree to comply with their terms.

### 11.2 Fees and Plans

Docito may charge subscription fees, transaction fees, and add-on fees such as storage or seats. Current pricing and plan terms are displayed in the Services. Fees are generally non-refundable unless required by law or explicitly stated.

### 11.3 Taxes

You are responsible for applicable taxes, duties, or government assessments.

---

## 12) Privacy, Security, and Health Data

### 12.1 Privacy

Our collection and use of personal data is described in our Privacy Policy.

### 12.2 Security Practices

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect data and maintain platform reliability. However, no system is perfectly secure.

### 12.3 PHI and HIPAA (U.S.)

If you are in the United States and you or your organization are subject to HIPAA, certain health-related data may qualify as PHI. Docito does not make a blanket claim of HIPAA compliance in these Terms.

If a U.S. healthcare organization requires a Business Associate Agreement (BAA), such support may be available only under a separate written agreement and only for eligible organizations and configurations.

---

## 13) Acceptable Use Policy

You agree not to violate any law or regulation, impersonate others or misrepresent credentials, attempt unauthorized access, scraping, or data harvesting, introduce malware or exploit vulnerabilities, use Docito for fraudulent billing or illegal activity, misuse healthcare workflows, or upload content that infringes rights or is unlawful.

We may suspend or terminate accounts for violations.

---

## 14) Content Ownership and License

### 14.1 Your Content

You retain ownership of your Content. You grant Docito a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to host, store, process, transmit, display, and create derivative technical copies of Content solely to operate, secure, and improve the Services and to provide features you request.

### 14.2 Our Intellectual Property

Docito, including software, designs, trademarks, logos, and branding, is owned by Artsy Developers Inc. or licensors. You may not copy, modify, reverse engineer, resell, or misuse the Services except as permitted by law.

### 14.3 Feedback

If you provide feedback or suggestions, you grant us the right to use them without restriction or compensation.

---

## 15) Third-Party Services

Docito may integrate with third-party services such as payments, messaging, analytics, mapping, storage, and others. We are not responsible for third-party services and their policies. Your use of third-party services may be subject to their own terms.

---

## 16) Disclaimers

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Docito is provided as is and as available. We disclaim all warranties, express or implied, including merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement.

Docito does not warrant that the Services will be uninterrupted, error-free, or secure.

---

## 17) Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law, Docito will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, and will not be liable for lost profits, lost data, or business interruption.

Docito’s total liability for any claim related to the Services will not exceed the amount paid by you to Docito in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim, or 100 USD if you paid nothing, unless required otherwise by law.

Some jurisdictions do not allow certain limitations, so parts of this section may not apply to you.

---

## 18) Indemnification

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Artsy Developers Inc., Docito, and our affiliates, officers, directors, employees, and agents from any claims, liabilities, damages, losses, and expenses arising from your use of the Services, your Content, your violation of these Terms, your interactions with other users, and for Providers and Facilities, healthcare services you provide and your compliance obligations.

---

## 19) Suspension and Termination

You may stop using Docito at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if you violate these Terms, your use creates risk to users or the platform, required by law or to prevent harm, or you fail to pay fees if applicable.

Upon termination, your right to use the Services ends. Sections that by nature should survive will survive.

---

## 20) Changes to the Services or Terms

We may update the Services and these Terms. We will update the Last Updated date and may provide notice for material changes where required by law. Continued use after changes become effective means you accept the updated Terms.

---

## 21) Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

Because Docito operates globally, governing law and dispute mechanism may depend on your location and any separate written agreements.

Governing Law: To be determined  
Venue or Arbitration: To be determined

---

## 22) Contact

**Docito® (Artsy Developers Inc.)**  
Support: **[support@docito.app](mailto:support@docito.app)**  
Address: Global

# Docito® Privacy Policy

**Effective Date:** 02.02.2026  
**Last Updated:** 02.02.2026

Docito provides a global healthcare management platform for Care Seekers, healthcare Providers, and Facilities, including clinics and practices, laboratories, imaging centers, and pharmacies. Docito includes tools for scheduling, staff workflows, messaging, records and files, referrals, verification, insurance information, analytics, and related services.

Docito® is a registered trademark and brand of **Artsy Developers Inc.**

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect information when you use our Services and what choices you have. If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, do not use the Services.

---

## 1) Who We Are and How to Contact Us

Company: Artsy Developers Inc.  
Brand: Docito® (registered trademark and brand)  
Support: **[support@docito.app](mailto:support@docito.app)**  
Privacy Contact (optional): **[privacy@docito.app](mailto:privacy@docito.app)**  
Address: Global

Docito operates globally. Where local laws apply, we comply with applicable requirements.

---

## 2) Who This Policy Applies To

This policy applies to visitors to public pages and to users of the platform, including Care Seekers, Providers, Facilities, Staff, Admins, and Super-Admins.

---

## 3) Information We Collect

The information we collect depends on your role and how you use Docito.

### A) Information you provide directly

We may collect account and profile information, booking details, messages and support requests, insurance information you enter, and files or notes you upload. Providers and Facilities may provide professional profiles, facility details, scheduling settings, staff permissions, and verification information if submitted.

### B) Information collected automatically

We may collect usage and device data such as device and browser type, operating system, IP address, approximate location derived from IP (for example city or country), pages visited and interactions, timestamps, performance metrics, and error logs and diagnostics.

### C) Information from third parties (if enabled)

We may receive data from payment processors (payment status and transaction IDs, not full card numbers), email or SMS providers (delivery status and message metadata), verification providers (status metadata), and analytics or monitoring tools (aggregated signals).

---

## 4) Health Data, PHI, and Sensitive Information

Some information on Docito may be health-related. In the United States, certain identifiable health information handled in regulated contexts may be considered PHI under HIPAA.

Docito does not provide medical services and does not create a doctor–patient relationship with Docito. Providers and Facilities control what clinical information is entered in their workflows and are responsible for complying with applicable laws and professional obligations.

---

## 5) How We Use Information

We use information to operate the Services, manage accounts, deliver role-based features, provide bookings and notifications, enable messaging and referrals, store and retrieve records and files, provide customer support, protect accounts and prevent fraud, process payments and subscriptions where enabled, improve reliability and performance, and comply with law and enforce our Terms.

---

## 6) Legal Bases for Processing (Where Required)

Depending on your location, we process personal data under one or more legal bases such as contract necessity, legitimate interests, consent, and legal obligations.

---

## 7) How We Share Information

We share information only as needed.

- Role-based sharing: booking information is shared with the selected Provider or Facility to fulfill the booking. Staff access depends on assigned permissions. Referral information may be shared between organizations to coordinate referrals.
- Service providers: we use vendors for hosting, databases, storage, email and SMS, payments, analytics, and monitoring. They may process data only to provide services to us under appropriate protections.
- Legal and safety: we may disclose information to comply with law, investigate abuse or fraud, protect users and the platform, and enforce agreements.
- Business transfers: information may be transferred as part of a merger, acquisition, financing, restructuring, or sale of assets, subject to appropriate safeguards.

We do not sell personal information in the traditional sense.

---

## 8) International Use and Cross-Border Transfers

Docito operates globally. Data may be stored or processed in different countries depending on service configuration and provider infrastructure. Where required, we use safeguards intended to protect data during cross-border transfers.

---

## 9) Data Retention

We retain information for as long as needed to provide the Services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and maintain security and auditability. Providers and Facilities are responsible for retaining records as required by applicable medical and health regulations.

---

## 10) Security

We use reasonable security measures appropriate for a modern SaaS platform, which may include encryption in transit, role-based access control, monitoring and logging, and internal access controls. No system is 100 percent secure. You are responsible for keeping your credentials safe and configuring permissions responsibly.

---

## 11) Your Rights and Choices

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, export, object to, or restrict processing of personal data, withdraw consent where applicable, and opt out of marketing communications.

To exercise rights, contact **[support@docito.app](mailto:support@docito.app)**.

---

## 12) Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies and similar technologies for authentication and security, remembering preferences such as language and UI settings, and performance analytics where enabled and consented where required.

---

## 13) HIPAA and BAA Note (U.S.)

Docito does not make a blanket claim of HIPAA compliance. We use privacy-first, security-focused, HIPAA-aligned practices. If a U.S. healthcare organization requires a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for regulated workflows, BAA support may be available upon request only under a separate written agreement and only for eligible organizations and configurations.

---

## 14) Children’s Privacy

Docito is not intended for children without parent or guardian involvement as required by local law. If you believe a child provided personal information without appropriate consent, contact **[support@docito.app](mailto:support@docito.app)**.

---

## 15) Third-Party Links and Services

Our Services may link to third-party websites or services. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies, not ours.

---

## 16) Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will update the Last Updated date and may provide additional notice where required by law. Continued use after updates means you accept the updated policy.

---

## 17) Contact Us

**Docito® (Artsy Developers Inc.)**  
Support: **[support@docito.app](mailto:support@docito.app)**  
Address: Global

# Docito® Cookie Policy

Effective Date: 02.02.2026
Last Updated: 02.02.2026

This Cookie Policy explains how Docito® ("Docito," "we," "us," "our") uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit or use our websites, applications, dashboards, and related services (the "Services").

Docito® is a registered trademark/brand of Artsy Developers Inc.
Contact: support@docito.app
Address: Global

This policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy.

## 1) What Cookies Are

Cookies are small text files that a website places on your device (computer, phone, tablet) to remember information about your visit. Cookies can be:
- First-party cookies (set by Docito), or
- Third-party cookies (set by service providers we use)

We also use similar technologies, such as:
- Local Storage or Session Storage (browser storage used to remember preferences)
- Pixels or Tags (small snippets used for measurement)
- SDKs (in-app libraries, if applicable)

For simplicity, we refer to all of these technologies as cookies in this Cookie Policy.

## 2) Why We Use Cookies

We use cookies to:

### A) Provide core functionality (Strictly Necessary)

These cookies are required to operate the Services, such as:
- keeping you signed in (authentication and session)
- protecting against fraud and abuse
- maintaining security and reliability
- remembering essential settings required to run the platform

### B) Remember preferences (Preferences)

These cookies help personalize your experience, such as:
- saving your preferred language
- remembering UI preferences (for example, theme)
- saving basic UI settings

### C) Understand performance and improve the platform (Analytics)

These cookies help us understand how the Services are used so we can improve performance and user experience, such as:
- aggregated page usage patterns
- performance metrics
- error and diagnostic information

Where required by law, we enable analytics cookies only after you give consent.

### D) Marketing (Optional)

If enabled, marketing cookies help:
- measure marketing campaign performance
- show relevant ads and prevent repetitive ads

Where required by law, we enable marketing cookies only after you give consent. If we are not using marketing cookies at a given time, this category may be inactive.

## 3) Types of Cookies We Use

The cookies used by Docito can fall into these categories.

### 3.1 Strictly Necessary Cookies (Always On)

Purpose: Security, authentication, basic platform operation.
Examples of what they do:
- maintain login sessions
- support secure authentication flows
- help prevent unauthorized access and abuse

These cookies are required and cannot be disabled via cookie settings without affecting core functionality.

### 3.2 Preference Cookies

Purpose: Save settings and improve experience.
Examples:
- storing your selected language (often stored in browser storage such as localStorage, for example a key like i18nextLng)
- remembering theme preference
- remembering minor UI settings

### 3.3 Analytics Cookies (Consent-Based Where Required)

Purpose: Measure usage and improve performance.
Examples:
- aggregated usage analytics
- diagnostics and performance monitoring

### 3.4 Marketing Cookies (Consent-Based Where Required)

Purpose: Advertising measurement and personalization (if enabled).
Examples:
- ad conversion tracking
- retargeting measurement

## 4) Cookie Duration

Cookies may be:
- Session cookies: deleted when you close your browser
- Persistent cookies: remain on your device for a set period or until you delete them

Preference cookies are commonly persistent so your settings (like language) remain when you return.

## 5) Your Choices and Controls

### A) Cookie Banner and Cookie Settings

Where legally required, we provide a cookie banner that lets you:
- accept all cookies
- reject non-essential cookies
- choose categories

You can change your preferences at any time using a Cookie Settings link or button in the footer (if available).

### B) Browser Controls

Most browsers allow you to:
- view cookies stored on your device
- delete cookies
- block cookies (including third-party cookies)

Blocking cookies may cause parts of Docito to stop working (especially sign-in and dashboards).

### C) Mobile Device Controls

On mobile devices, you may be able to control tracking permissions through your operating system settings.

## 6) Third-Party Cookies and Providers

Some third-party service providers may set cookies or similar identifiers when you use Docito (for example, payment processors or analytics providers if enabled). Their use of cookies is governed by their own policies.

Docito does not control third-party cookies once set by third parties, but we work to choose reputable vendors and limit unnecessary data sharing.

## 7) Do Not Track (DNT)

Some browsers support a Do Not Track setting. At this time, Docito does not respond to DNT signals in a uniform way, unless required by applicable law.

## 8) Updates to This Cookie Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in technology, legal requirements, or how Docito operates. We will update the Last Updated date when changes are made.

## 9) Contact Us

If you have questions about this Cookie Policy, contact:
- Docito® (Artsy Developers Inc.)
- Email: support@docito.app
- Address: Global

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.summary: Appointment cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours may be subject to a cancellation fee at the provider's discretion. No-shows are non-refundable. Subscription fees are non-refundable once a billing period has started. For disputes, contact support@docito.com within 7 days of the charge.
